patterns.note: Content is consistently centered within a max-width container, while section backgrounds (colors or gradients) extend full-bleed across the viewport.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings (often in bright blue) are used for key messages, contrasted with lighter body text and distinct monospaced font for code examples within dark, rounded containers.
A core palette of deep blues, bright blues, and whites/light greys is used, often incorporating subtle blue gradients for visual depth and to highlight specific content blocks or feature cards.

Sections and content blocks animate into view with a subtle fade-up and slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience. The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top.
Realistic terminal and code editor UI screenshots are integrated as prominent visual elements within hero sections and feature explanations, reinforcing the developer-centric nature of the product.

technique_notes: Sections and content blocks are revealed with a subtle fade-up and slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated using a JavaScript library to trigger CSS keyframes or Lottie animations based on scroll position. The main navigation bar is fixed at the top of the viewport without any size or background transformations.

Realistic terminal and code editor UIs are integrated as hero elements and within feature explanations by rendering them within dark, rounded containers using a distinct monospaced font to mimic a development environment.

Full-width sections utilize varying background colors or gradients, with all textual and interactive content consistently constrained to a central maximum width, ensuring readability and a structured layout.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (H1 ~4-5x body, H2 ~3x body) establish clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded; buttons, cards, and code block containers consistently feature a moderate corner radius (e.g., 8-12px).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; sections have generous vertical padding, and content within sections is well-spaced, creating a clean and readable layout, with the hero section being particularly airy.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its seamless integration of realistic terminal and code editor UIs directly into the content, using a dedicated monospaced font and dark, rounded containers to authentically represent a developer environment. This visual theme is consistently applied, making the technical aspects of the product feel tangible and accessible within the marketing context.
